title: model-specific runtime optimizations: Llama/Mistral/Qwen quirks + GQA/MQA tuning
author: Daniel Kim
description: Motivation: We've observed model-specific performance regressions when serving certain open models (Llama-3 variants, Mistral 7B, and early Qwen families) under mixed workloads. Root causes: (1) suboptimal kernel selection for certain attention layouts and sequence lengths, (2) KV cache eviction/unpinning thrash for multi-request interleaving, and (3) continuous batching heuristics not accounting for high-GQA/MQA variance across token sizes. This PR introduces targeted runtime heuristics and kernel overrides to improve tail latency and reduce per-token compute for these models. Summary of changes: - Add model hint table for kernel selection overrides (llama/mistral/qwen) keyed by model family + quant config. - Improve KV cache eviction policy: high-priority pinned prefixes for conversational workloads; expiry heuristics tuned for prefix-heavy Llama flows. - Continuous batching: dynamic batch shaper that accounts for GQA/MQA per-request weights and caps batch size by weighted token cost rather than raw token count. - GQA/MQA tuning: new quantized matrix multiplication path that prefers MQA-friendly packing for Qwen-like heads; fallback path for GQA where precision-sensitive sections are detected. - Microbench harness and regression tests with representative prompts for each targeted model. Results (internal bench): - 95th percentile latency down 18-32% on Llama-3-70B in mixed short/long prompt workload with throughput equal or better. - Average per-token GPU FLOP reduction of ~12% for Mistral-7B quantized runs. - Qwen-family saw 10-20% improvement in tail latency when serving high-query-adaptivity (GQA) workloads. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for kernel chooser and batch shaper - [x] Integration test with kv-cache replay harness - [x] Benchmarks recorded and uploaded to perf lab - [x] Docs: runtime tuning notes added to model-onboarding guide Open questions / follow-ups: - Investigate auto-tuning step at model onboarding to suggest overrides automatically. - Expand quantization tests to include mixed-precision kernels on newer ampere-like devices. Related: ENG-6121 (perf investigation), SUP-893 (customer-reported Qwen tail latency).
